title: Hear the left hand arrive
prompt: The Saints — listen for the bass notes landing on the downbeats in the second half.
successRule: Listen through once.

generatorParams.promptText: The left hand plays one anchor note per bar — right on beat 1.

title: Left-hand home
prompt: Before the left hand plays in time, it needs a home: pinky resting on the C below middle C. All three roots this tier uses live under that one calm hand — no reaching, no jumping.
successRule: Play the four roots in place — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Anchor the downbeat
prompt: One C in the bass, every bar, exactly on beat 1. Let it ring.
successRule: Finish the pattern — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Find the bass keys
prompt: C, F, and G live below middle C too — the map repeats everywhere.
successRule: Play all 6 asked-for keys correctly.

title: Roots that move
prompt: C, then F, then G — the bass tells the harmony where to go.
successRule: Two stars on the changing roots — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Both hands, one pulse
prompt: Your first hands-together playing — a five-finger walk over a steady bass anchor. Not the song yet: just the feeling of two hands sharing one pulse.
successRule: Every note right, both hands; a slip means a replay.

title: Checkpoint: moving roots, no help
prompt: The changing roots again — no falling notes, chord symbols only.
successRule: Two stars with no visual help — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The staff points the way
prompt: Notes climbing the staff climb the keyboard. Bar lines slice the beats.
successRule: Answer all 5 correctly.

title: Same or different?
prompt: Two notes — trust your ears before your eyes.
successRule: Get all 6 right.

title: Two beats to a bar
prompt: 2/4 is a march: ONE-two, ONE-two. Half the bar of 4/4.
successRule: Answer all 5 correctly.

title: Tap a 2/4 march
prompt: Feel the accent land every TWO beats now, not every four.
successRule: 70% of taps in time.

title: Tier 2 check: reading and meter
prompt: Staff direction, bar lines, and 2/4 vs 4/4 — the Tier 2 knowledge check.
successRule: Answer every question correctly.

title: Watch the Saints march
prompt: Notice the pickup — the melody starts before the first full bar.
successRule: Listen through once.

generatorParams.promptText: The tune starts on beat 2 — a pickup. Count the empty beat 1.

title: Place both hands
prompt: Set up the song before you play a bar of it: right thumb on middle C, pinky on G — that frame plays the whole melody. Left pinky on the low C — the roots live there.
successRule: Every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The rising call (bars 1–4)
prompt: The famous four notes, twice. Four bars — this is the whole first phrase.
successRule: Every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The answer (bars 5–8)
prompt: Same start, different landing — the phrase that answers the call. Four more bars and you own the first half.
successRule: Every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Join the phrases: the first half
prompt: The call and the answer, back to back — bars 1–8 in one take.
successRule: Finish the phrase — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The bass line alone (bars 9–16)
prompt: Left hand only — the second half’s whole bass part is eight notes. Learn it by itself so it feels automatic before the melody joins.
successRule: Every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Hands together, one chunk (bars 9–12)
prompt: Just four bars with both hands. Small enough to get right, big enough to feel the song.
successRule: Every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Hands together: the whole second half
prompt: The chunk you just played, extended to the end of the song — bars 9–16, both hands.
successRule: Finish the section — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: The whole song
prompt: All sixteen bars. If a note slips, the next downbeat is your friend.
successRule: Earn at least one star — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Start from the second half
prompt: Entering mid-song proves the music lives in you, not on the screen.
successRule: Two stars on the second half — every note right; a slip means a replay.

title: Performance: When the Saints
prompt: Full tempo, both hands, no help. March it home.
successRule: Earn the mastery star: three stars at 96 BPM, no assists — every note right; a slip means a replay.
